implementation_summary: defaultConnect returns the raw Buffer alongside the UTF-8 body. safeGet ok results carry bytes. makeOutboundFetch returns an OutboundFetchFn (FetchedResponse plus bytes()), which is assignable to FetchFn. The cap still applies to raw chunk sizes; an over-cap response gives status, empty text and empty bytes.
